sub_fields.label: Slides
sub_fields.name: slider_images
sub_fields.instructions: Add as many slides as needed. Each slide shows a desktop and mobile image.

sub_fields.label: Desktop Image
sub_fields.name: hero_image
sub_fields.instructions: Recommended: 2560 x 1200px

sub_fields.label: Mobile Image
sub_fields.name: hero_mobile_image
sub_fields.instructions: Recommended: 768 x 900px

sub_fields.label: Button
sub_fields.name: intro_button
sub_fields.instructions: Supports mailto: URLs for email CTAs

sub_fields.label: Bottom Button Link
sub_fields.name: bottom_button_link
sub_fields.instructions: Optional second button shown below the slider. Uses the default button style unless overridden below.

sub_fields.label: Bottom Button — Background Color
sub_fields.name: bottom_button_bg_color
sub_fields.instructions: Overrides the bottom button background. Leave blank for the default.

sub_fields.label: Bottom Button — Text Color
sub_fields.name: bottom_button_text_color
sub_fields.instructions: Overrides the bottom button text color. Leave blank for the default.

sub_fields.label: Bottom Button — Text Size (px)
sub_fields.name: bottom_button_text_size
sub_fields.instructions: Overrides the bottom button text size. Leave blank for the default.

sub_fields.label: Slide Title Size — Desktop (px)
sub_fields.name: text_size
sub_fields.instructions: Overrides the title size for every show card in this slider. Leave blank for the default (responsive).

sub_fields.label: Slide Title Size — Mobile (px)
sub_fields.name: text_size_mobile
sub_fields.instructions: Title size for every show card on screens ≤767px. Leave blank to use the desktop value.

sub_fields.label: Max Width
sub_fields.name: max_width
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Restricts image group width and centres it. Example: 800px or 60%

sub_fields.label: Number Text
sub_fields.name: number_text
sub_fields.instructions: Appended to number. Example: M, %

sub_fields.label: Slides
sub_fields.name: slider_images
sub_fields.instructions: Add as many slides as needed. Each slide shows a desktop and mobile image.

sub_fields.label: Desktop Image
sub_fields.name: hero_image
sub_fields.instructions: Recommended: 2560 x 1200px

sub_fields.label: Mobile Image
sub_fields.name: hero_mobile_image
sub_fields.instructions: Recommended: 768 x 900px

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow Prefix
sub_fields.name: eyebrow_prefix
sub_fields.instructions: Prefix used to auto-build eyebrow labels (e.g. "STORY" produces "STORY 01", "STORY 02" …). Override per slide if needed.

sub_fields.label: Autoplay Interval (ms)
sub_fields.name: autoplay_ms
sub_fields.instructions: Hold time per slide in milliseconds. Default 6000.

sub_fields.label: Disable Autoplay
sub_fields.name: disable_autoplay
sub_fields.instructions: Turn on to stop the slider from auto-advancing. Autoplay is enabled by default.

sub_fields.label: Section Background Color
sub_fields.name: background_color
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Color shown behind the slider section (visible around the rounded card edges).

sub_fields.label: Section Title
sub_fields.name: section_title
sub_fields.instructions: Optional heading shown above the slider, centered.

sub_fields.label: Section Title Color
sub_fields.name: section_title_color
sub_fields.instructions: Defaults to white.

sub_fields.label: Slides
sub_fields.name: slides
sub_fields.instructions: Add at least 2 slides.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow Override
sub_fields.name: eyebrow_override
sub_fields.instructions: Leave blank to auto-generate (e.g. "STORY 01", "STORY 02"). The prefix comes from the slider's "Eyebrow Prefix" field; the number is the slide position.

sub_fields.label: Button (optional)
sub_fields.name: button
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to hide the CTA on this slide.

sub_fields.label: Text Container Max Width (px)
sub_fields.name: text_max_width
sub_fields.instructions: Caps how wide the title/body can grow on desktop. Leave blank for default (640px). Use this instead of manual line breaks so wrapping stays consistent on mobile.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow Size — Desktop (px)
sub_fields.name: eyebrow_size
sub_fields.instructions: Override eyebrow font size on desktop/tablet. Leave blank for default (responsive 12–14px).

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow Size — Mobile (px)
sub_fields.name: eyebrow_size_mobile
sub_fields.instructions: Override eyebrow font size on screens ≤767px. Leave blank to inherit the desktop value (or default if that's blank too).

sub_fields.label: Title Size — Desktop (px)
sub_fields.name: title_size
sub_fields.instructions: Override title font size on desktop/tablet. Leave blank for default (responsive 34–64px).

sub_fields.label: Title Size — Mobile (px)
sub_fields.name: title_size_mobile
sub_fields.instructions: Override title font size on screens ≤767px.

sub_fields.label: Body Size — Desktop (px)
sub_fields.name: body_size
sub_fields.instructions: Override body font size on desktop/tablet. Leave blank for default (responsive 15–18px).

sub_fields.label: Body Size — Mobile (px)
sub_fields.name: body_size_mobile
sub_fields.instructions: Override body font size on screens ≤767px.

sub_fields.label: All Text Color
sub_fields.name: text_color
sub_fields.instructions: Sets the color for every text item on this slide (eyebrow, title, body, button, counter). Leave blank for the default white. Per-item colors below override this.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow Color
sub_fields.name: eyebrow_color
sub_fields.instructions: Overrides the eyebrow color on this slide. Leave blank to use the All Text Color.

sub_fields.label: Title Color
sub_fields.name: title_color
sub_fields.instructions: Overrides the title color on this slide. Leave blank to use the All Text Color.

sub_fields.label: Body Color
sub_fields.name: body_color
sub_fields.instructions: Overrides the body color on this slide. Leave blank to use the All Text Color.

sub_fields.label: Right Card (Counter) Color
sub_fields.name: counter_color
sub_fields.instructions: Overrides the whole stat / counter card color (right side, desktop). The two fields below override this for the number and label individually. Leave blank to use the All Text Color.

sub_fields.label: Counter Number Color
sub_fields.name: counter_number_color
sub_fields.instructions: Color of the big stat number (e.g. "3.7B+"). Leave blank to use the Right Card color.

sub_fields.label: Counter Label Color
sub_fields.name: counter_label_color
sub_fields.instructions: Color of the label text under the number (e.g. "HOURS CONSUMED") and the description. Leave blank to use the Right Card color.

sub_fields.label: Desktop Background
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Recommended: 2560 x 1200px

sub_fields.label: Mobile Background
sub_fields.name: mobile_image
sub_fields.instructions: Recommended: 768 x 900px. Falls back to desktop if empty.

sub_fields.label: Stat Prefix
sub_fields.name: stat_prefix
sub_fields.instructions: Optional, e.g. "$".

sub_fields.label: Stat Number
sub_fields.name: stat_number
sub_fields.instructions: Headline number, e.g. "325" or "4,500". Counter animates 0 → this value. Leave the entire stat block empty to hide the counter card on this slide.

sub_fields.label: Stat Suffix
sub_fields.name: stat_suffix
sub_fields.instructions: Optional small superscript, e.g. "+" or "%".

sub_fields.label: Stat Unit
sub_fields.name: stat_unit
sub_fields.instructions: Smaller label beneath the number, e.g. "BILLION".

sub_fields.label: Stat Description
sub_fields.name: stat_description
sub_fields.instructions: Supporting copy below the counter.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Optional heading shown above the image.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: The clickable image. Recommended: 1600x800.

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: Where the image and title link to.

sub_fields.label: Background Color
sub_fields.name: background_color
sub_fields.instructions: Section background. Defaults to black.

sub_fields.label: Text Color
sub_fields.name: text_color
sub_fields.instructions: Title color. Defaults to white.

sub_fields.label: Size
sub_fields.name: size
sub_fields.instructions: Vertical space added between sections. All values are responsive (scale fluidly between phone and desktop).

sub_fields.label: Background Color
sub_fields.name: background_color
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Leave blank for transparent.

sub_fields.label: Video File
sub_fields.name: video_file
sub_fields.instructions: Upload an MP4 (H.264, web-optimized). Plays muted, looped, autoplays inline. Recommended: 1920x1080 or 2560x1440.

sub_fields.label: Poster Image
sub_fields.name: poster
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Shown before the video loads and as a still on devices that block autoplay.

fields.label: Disable Section Dot Nav
fields.name: disable_section_nav
fields.instructions: The fixed dot navigator on the right edge is on by default (desktop only, ≥1024px). Toggle on to hide it on this page.
